title: Isolate real-policy storage fixtures before imports
summary: Use owned selected and primary roots, preserve real authorization, and isolate process-global audit state.
reusable_steps: Use owned selected and primary roots, preserve real authorization, and isolate process-global audit state
expected_outcome: Storage boundary tests should create an owned scratch checkout with real product policies and schemas, set root environment before importing the heavy I/O stack, and assert selected and primary roots. Initialize once per file; reset per-case owned state without rebuilding the full authority stack. Module resets alone do not replace a process-global audit singleton: save and restore its exact descriptor around the fixture. Scan all owned public runtime, scratch and mission outputs rather than parallel suites' checkouts. Keep real issuers/schema validation and restore inherited provider-selection environment. Copy regenerable fixture inputs with guarded copy APIs; do not increase timeouts or weaken authorization to hide setup costs. See operations-hygiene-runbook section 5.
